name: vam.gate_default
doc: The generated form for a playbook gate that has only a response_schema. The IR depends on the gate, so the file holds the static frame plus the generator rule 'form'. Rule, for each property of data.response_schema (required ones first, then the rest, each in name order, because a protobuf Struct keeps no order): string with enum -> Select; string, format date -> DateInput; string, format vam-workspace-file -> FileInput; string with maxLength over 200 -> TextArea; other string -> Input; number or integer -> NumberInput (minimum and maximum become min and max); boolean -> Toggle; array of strings with items.enum -> MultiSelect; anything else is refused. The label is the property's title, else its name. The state default is the property's default, else '' / 0 (or minimum) / false / []. The submit button lists every property in 'with'. The result is validated against data.response_schema itself, so a selection can hold only offered items.
